record_scope_reconstruction: AFP reports June 25 2020 full closure of the Saint-Georges road bridge in the Brazil-to-France direction. INSEE dates the Brazil frontier reopening December 18 2021, and France-Guyane specifically confirms reopened Oyapock road bridge. Earlier March rule has broader/exceptional admission scope and is not automatically attached to this bridge.

source_checks.finding: AFP full body quotes prefecture on Saint-Georges bridge closed Brazil-to-France after Thursday evening measures.
INSEE chronology dates reopening December 18 2021, with no assumption all river movements had stopped.
Retrieved article body/visible extract specifically states bridge open since December 18 and local river passage was never wholly stopped.
